classification.countable_rule: excludes optional ingredients, water, salt, black pepper, and cooking oils
classification.notes: Effort: shredding a head of cabbage and slicing (1); covered cooking with flips in two batches (periodic, 1); pancake + made sauce + toppings (1); flipping thick pancakes / doneness judgment (1); one skillet with two batches (1). Sum 5 = moderate. Complexity: 12 countable required ingredients (water, salt, oil, optional aonori and beni shoga excluded) -> 1; two widely available specialty items (bonito flakes and Japanese mayo, both in the international aisle of major chains) -> 1; batter + sauce builds -> 1; sourcing scored once under specialty -> 0. Sum 3 = standard. WAVE proposed adventurous because it assumed bottled okonomi sauce + required aonori; this package makes the sauce from ketchup/Worcestershire/soy and leaves aonori/beni shoga optional, which lowers real shopping burden.
